page.content:
Liberated Borg who becomes Voyager's hardest student of humanity.

How Seven of Nine connects

  • Faction: Voyager crew — Seven of Nine becomes part of the Voyager crew.
  • Faction: Borg Collective — Seven was a drone of the Borg Collective.

What is Seven of Nine?

Seven of Nine is the Borg drone Janeway severs from the Collective, then the crew member who relearns personhood in the Delta Quadrant.

Key threads lead to Voyager crew and Borg Collective.
